mission: Turn a reserved basket into a ready pickup.
why_it_exists: Dispatch must wait for a real, prepared basket.
design_decisions: Repeated queue deliveries cannot pick twice.
known_limits: Picking time is simulated; there is no warehouse integration.

tool_descriptions.fulfillment.pick: Pick a reserved basket once and signal readiness.
tool_descriptions.fulfillment.read: Inspect a reserved basket and its picking state.
tool_descriptions.memory.read: Recall evidence inside the current run, role and order scope.
tool_descriptions.memory.write: Append a bounded memory observation with provenance.
tool_descriptions.queue.publish: Publish an allowed topic to a permitted recipient.
